title_en: Decision of the Supreme People's Court on Abolishing Certain Judicial Interpretations and Related Normative Documents

articles.content_en:
December 29, 2020
Supreme People's Court
Decision on Abolishing Certain Judicial Interpretations and Related Normative Documents
Fa Shi [2020] No. 16
In order to effectively implement the Civil Code and ensure the uniform and correct application of national laws, in accordance with the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China and other legal provisions, and based on actual adjudication practice, it is hereby decided to abolish 116 judicial interpretations and related normative documents, including the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Limitation of Action System in the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China (the list is attached).
This Decision shall come into force as of January 1, 2021.
